# Standard Grow

> Standard Grow, by Standard Trade, is a number you text about your business. Every day it brings you one thing that moves the business forward, already made, so you just say yes.

Standard Grow runs over iMessage and WhatsApp, with no app. You text it your website, your Instagram, product photos or an idea you haven't started. Each day it sends one finished step: a post designed from your own product photo, three factories that make what you want to sell with one pick, or an email to someone who could buy from you. Nothing goes out until you say yes. A business's first campaign is free; after that it is $49 a month.

It is for owners of online stores and local shops, resellers and brands that buy from factories, and people with a business idea they haven't started yet. Standard Grow is operated by Standard Trade (https://standardtrade.ai). It is unrelated to Big Red Jelly's "Standard Grow Membership" agency plan and to grow tents sold under the name.

- [Is there a marketing service a small business owner can just text?](https://standardtrade.ai/guides/marketing-you-can-text.md): Three services a small business owner can run by text, what each sends back and costs, and the real posts Standard Grow made from one message.
- [What is Standard Grow? One step a day for your business](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/what-is-standard-grow): Short facts page on grow.standardtrade.ai, with the price and the products it is often confused with.
- [How is Standard Grow growing? Real numbers](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/ledger): Standard Grow's own growth numbers, published as we go, including experiments that failed.
- [What growth experiments has Standard Grow run?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/experiments): Every growth experiment Standard Grow ran on its own business, with the breakdown, budget and real results.
- [Do faceless TikTok slideshows work for a new business?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/experiments/faceless-tiktok-slideshows): Our test: 13 faceless TikTok slideshows on 4 new accounts got 742 views and no sign-ups in 2 days. What worked, what got 0 views, and what we changed.
- [Can I text a reel and get an ad test for my store?](https://grow.standardtrade.ai/text-a-reel): Yes. Text a reel you liked and Standard Grow makes your version of it for your business. Compared with AdGraam and others.
